chunks: And in the narration of Jamil ibn Darraj:
Abu Abdillah عليه السلام was asked about a man who married a woman and then divorced her before consummating the marriage: is her daughter permissible for him?
He said: "The mother and the daughter are equal in this matter. If he did not consummate the marriage with one of them, the other becomes permissible for him."

key_terms.سَوَاءٌ: equal in legal status in this matter
key_terms.يَدْخُلَ بِهَا: to consummate the marriage with her

ai.seo_question: If a man divorces a woman before consummation, can he marry her daughter?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding marriage impediments between a woman and her daughter. It states that if marriage with one of them was not consummated, then the other remains permissible for marriage.
